title: Patient Empowerment through immersive hospital experiences before operations or procedures
summary: The aim of PERISKOP is to create immersive 360° films that will be made available on virtual reality (VR) headsets within the clinic and on an online portal to improve patient preparation for their hospital stay at Charité - Universitätsmedizin Berlin. As a new approach to support patient education, the application is to be piloted in workflows on three wards. Using immersive 360° videos, patients will be able to get to know key processes of their patient journey and the associated rooms realistically even before their stay in hospital. In the spirit of patient empowerment, potentially anxiety-inducing situations should be made tangible in the run-up to treatment in order to alleviate worries about the unknown.
conditions: The study does is a supportive and complementary method to clinical procedures and does not offer medical treatment (please see the project description).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
– Adult patients (≥ 18 years of age) who
are scheduled to be admitted to the
intensive care unit.
– Capacity to consent to participation in the
study.
– No previous ICU stays for
the condition in question.
Exclusion criteria:
Presence of epilepsy or other
disorders that could trigger seizures due to VR-visualized stimuli
Previous intensive ICU stays in
the patient concerned.
Known presence of mental disorders that
could be negatively affected by the study
Participants who have already taken part in the
PERISKOP study.
